component.ell_comps.magnitude-saturation.subject: component
component.ell_comps.magnitude-saturation.summary: The conversion maps every magnitude at or above 0.999 to q=0.000500250125062532. NumPy reaches the thin valid annulus below one but its constructor guard blocks the beyond-unit region; JAX arrays and tracers bypass that concrete-scalar guard.
component.ell_comps.magnitude-saturation.title: ell_comps magnitude saturates at 0.999
